# Sky States

> Sky States LLC is a career-focused technology training platform helping working professionals, students, freshers, and career advancers. Become job-ready and transition into high-demand technology and AI careers through live training, hands-on projects, expert mentorship, career preparation, and placement support in data science & AI, cybersecurity & ethical hacking, DevOps, and cloud computing.

### Core Information
- [Company]: Sky States LLC
- [Official Website]: https://skystates.us
- [Primary Focus]: Technology training and career development in order to enable learners to develop skills and to transition into technology careers.
- [Careers Accelerated]: 5,000+
- [Placement Rate]: 96%
- [Mentorship Model]: 1-on-1
- [Average Salary Lift]: 140%


### Who We Are
Sky States LLC is a career-focused technology platform, which serves students, freshers, working professionals, and career changers. Sky States offers instructor-led training, practical projects, mentorship, career preparation, and placement support in order to enable learners to develop technology skills and to pursue employment opportunities.

### Technology Education Programs
- [Data Science & AI]: Live instructor-led training plus practical projects covering Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, Data Visualization, Power BI, Tableau, and related technologies.
- [Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking]: Practical training covering Ethical Hacking, Penetration Testing, Digital Forensics, SOC, Cloud Security, and Incident Response.
- [DevOps & Cloud Computing]: Practical training covering Linux, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud technologies.
- [Offline Classes]: Instructor-led classroom training and practical lab programs.


### Learning Methodology
Sky States combines live instructor-led classes, hands-on labs, practical projects, real-world scenarios, and 1-on-1 mentorship in order to enable learners to develop applicable technology skills.


### Career Development & Job Readiness
Sky States enables learners beyond technical training by way of:
- Resume preparation
- LinkedIn profile optimization
- Portfolio development
- Interview preparation
- Mock interviews
- Career coaching
- Mentorship
- Certification preparation
- Job-search guidance
- Placement support

The objective is to enable learners to leverage their technical training and practical experience for job-ready skills and career opportunities.


### Jobs & Placement
Sky States combines its career-development programs with employment opportunities through career support and placement assistance and a Live Jobs resource.
Sky States enables learners to prepare for technology roles and to leverage current job opportunities.

### Career Outcomes
Sky States is focused on enabling learners to transition from learning and skill development, through to practical experience, job readiness, and employment opportunities.
Sky States career stories and outcomes are concerned with learners transitioning into technology roles and advancing their professional careers.

### Certifications & Industry Learning
Sky States offers training and certification preparation associated with Microsoft, AWS, and CompTIA, including Microsoft certification preparation, AWS Academy, and CompTIA Security+ preparation.


### Technologies & Ecosystems
Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Power BI, Tableau, Linux, Windows, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and related technologies.

### Learner & Career Use Cases
Sky States programs are relevant to:
- Students and freshers learning technology skills
- Working professionals seeking career growth
- Career changers entering IT
- IT professionals seeking technical upskilling
- Learners preparing for Data Science & AI careers
- Learners preparing for Cybersecurity careers
- Learners preparing for DevOps & Cloud careers
- Professionals preparing for technology certifications
- Job seekers preparing for technical interviews
- Learners seeking mentorship and placement support


### Security & Data Protection
Sky States states that it does not collect or store Social Security Numbers (SSNs), uses PCI-compliant third-party payment processors, and protects data transmitted to and from its platform using SSL/TLS encryption.
